headword: {郷土料理|きょうどりょうり}

definitions.gloss: local cuisine; regional dish; local specialty food
definitions.explanation: Traditional dishes associated with a particular region, using local ingredients and cooking methods passed down through generations. Composed of 郷土 (homeland, local area) + 料理 (cooking, dish).

examples.japanese: {沖縄|おきなわ}の{郷土料理|きょうどりょうり}を{食|た}べた。
{旅行先|りょこうさき}では{必|かなら}ず{郷土料理|きょうどりょうり}を{試|ため}すようにしている。
examples.english: When I travel, I always make sure to try the local cuisine.

examples.japanese: この{地域|ちいき}の{郷土料理|きょうどりょうり}は{新鮮|しんせん}な{海|うみ}の{幸|さち}を{使|つか}ったものが{多|おお}い。
examples.english: The local cuisine of this region features many dishes using fresh seafood.

notes:
USAGE:
{郷土料理|きょうどりょうり} is a common term in travel, tourism, and food culture. Each prefecture and region in Japan has its own {郷土料理|きょうどりょうり}, and exploring them is a major part of domestic travel.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {郷土料理|きょうどりょうり}を{味|あじ}わう (to savor local cuisine)
- {郷土料理|きょうどりょうり}の{店|みせ} (local cuisine restaurant)
- {名物|めいぶつ}{郷土料理|きょうどりょうり} (famous local dish)

EXAMPLES OF {郷土料理|きょうどりょうり}:
- {北海道|ほっかいどう}: ジンギスカン (Genghis Khan grilled lamb)
- {秋田|あきた}: きりたんぽ{鍋|なべ} (kiritanpo hot pot)
- {沖縄|おきなわ}: ゴーヤーチャンプルー (bitter melon stir-fry)
